title: WebGPU Mipmap Generation in Rust and wgpu
description: Generate a full mipmap chain with WebGPU render passes in Rust and wgpu. Learn texture views, WGSL downsampling, LOD, and anisotropic filtering on a tunnel.
imageAlt: A cylindrical tunnel lined with metal plates and rivets receding toward a dark center, with large nearby tiles and fine distant detail.
